description: This file contains shell script code for configuring and managing wireless network interfaces using mac80211 in OpenWRT. It includes functions for device initialization, interface configuration, capabilities handling, and management of various wireless modes such as mesh, adhoc, monitor, and station. The script interacts with external tools like iw, hostapd, and wpa_supplicant to set up wireless hardware and virtual interfaces.

methods.name: mac80211_add_capabilities
methods.description: Adds capability flags to a variable based on provided capability list and mask.

methods.name: mac80211_add_he_capabilities
methods.description: Adds HE (High Efficiency) capabilities flags based on input capability list.

methods.name: mac80211_hostapd_setup_base
methods.description: Sets up base configuration for hostapd for a given phy.

methods.name: mac80211_hostapd_setup_bss
methods.description: Configures hostapd for a specific BSS with given parameters.

methods.name: mac80211_get_addr
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address for a given wireless interface index.

methods.name: mac80211_generate_mac
methods.description: Generates a MAC address for a wireless device based on the base configuration.

methods.name: get_board_phy_name
methods.description: Finds the board-specific PHY name based on /etc/board.json data.

methods.name: rename_board_phy_by_path
methods.description: Renames the PHY based on its path.

methods.name: rename_board_phy_by_name
methods.description: Renames the PHY based on its name.

methods.name: find_phy
methods.description: Attempts to identify and rename the PHY based on various parameters like name, path, or MAC address.

methods.name: mac80211_check_ap
methods.description: Checks for the presence of an access point interface.

methods.name: mac80211_set_ifname
methods.description: Sets the interface name based on a prefix and type.

methods.name: mac80211_prepare_vif
methods.description: Prepares and configures a virtual interface.

methods.name: get_freq
methods.description: Retrieves the frequency for a given channel.

methods.name: chan_is_dfs
methods.description: Checks if a channel uses DFS (radar detection).

methods.name: mac80211_set_noscan
methods.description: Sets the no-scan mode.

methods.name: mac80211_reset_config
methods.description: Resets the configuration for a specified phy.

methods.name: mac80211_set_suffix
methods.description: Sets suffixes for radio and VIF names.

methods.name: drv_mac80211_setup
methods.description: Main function to initialize and configure mac80211 driver and interfaces.

methods.name: drv_mac80211_teardown
methods.description: Cleans up and resets the configuration for mac80211 driver.
